hypotheses.claim: Both posterior benefit probability and positive-benefit magnitude are learnable from strict-T0 diagnostics beyond content-only features

success.condition: Both 95% CI upper bounds < 0 and each endpoint has at least 4 of 5 seed point differences < 0
success.claim_impact: Allows total control to consider a separately preregistered Task46; no router claim yet

failure.condition: Either primary point difference >= 0 or shuffled-target control has 95% CI upper bound < 0 versus constant
failure.claim_impact: Close T0 benefit-learnability route; no Task46 and no C2 upgrade

inconclusive.condition: Either primary point difference < 0 but 95% CI includes 0 or seed negative-direction count < 4
inconclusive.claim_impact: Report insufficient precision; no Task46 and no affirmative learnability wording

guardrails.metric: sum of prohibited role old-dev and formal-test access events
source-group overlaps across FIT DIAG_CONFIRM ROUTER_CONFIRM
guardrails.kill_action: stop and repair identity only before any outcome access

guardrails.metric: absolute trial-count difference between full and G0 models

guardrails.kill_action: stop for leakage or implementation audit

stopping.rule: Fixed-data fixed-seed one-shot confirmation with no optional stopping
stopping.limit: 4 trials per target per feature set; 5 fixed seeds; 10000 cluster-bootstrap replicates
stopping.action_on_exhaustion: Report failure or inconclusive; do not add seeds models data or endpoints

amendment_policy.deviation_log: WORK_LOG.md and a versioned Task45 preregistration amendment
